EmailTemplate.description: Email to BPLs about staff shortages and how to continue to help.
EmailTemplate.name: Evergreen_General_Staff Shortages
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Continued Impact
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <<Insert BPL Name>>,
Thank you for your partnership as we continue to experience staff shortages.
Though your blood drive has been affected, please know your role as a Blood Program Leader remains invaluable, as you continue to make an impact on the lives of so many patients and their loved ones.
We are actively working to hire more staff and are doing everything we can to keep blood drives as planned. Balancing blood drives with patient need is a daily effort that requires assessing available resources to make the best choices to protect patient care, our volunteer partners and staff.
There are still ways you can help!
- Reschedule your blood drive: I’d love to discuss a new date for your blood drive.
- Donate blood, if eligible: To make an appointment or to learn more, download the American Red Cross Blood Donor App, visit RedCrossBlood.org, call 1-800-RED CROSS (1-800-733-2767) or enable the Blood Donor Skill on any Alexa Echo device.
- Support local blood drives: We also have locations where we are still able to run with our limited resources and would appreciate your support in sharing drive opportunities with your network.
